thread:
Alex Chen: quick sync thread — we need a call on Q3 security roadmap prioritization. big asks from enterprise sales: per-tenant retention controls, exportable audit bundles, KMS/HSM rotation semantics, and SOC2 evidence automation. proposing three options below, please comment with tradeoffs, blockers, and volunteer owners. TL;DR: my recommendation is to prioritize audit logs + export first, then KMS policies, then UI for retention tiers. 

Priya Nair: sounds good. main risk is retention cost + proof-of-chain for exports. SOC2 wants tamper-evident logs and playbook for access. need design for hashed/anchored audit bundles. :warning:

Morgan Blake: FYI sales asked for 7-year retention for one EU customer + quick export for legal hold. that will impact storage + egress. we should map to OKRs: Security reliability + Enterprise revenue enablement. can we get rough cost delta?

Lee Torres: rough notes from infra perspective: implementing per-tenant retention requires metadata partitioning, lifecycle rules, and an export pipeline that can produce a signed bundle. also re-encryption during HSM rotation is tricky at scale. options: 
1) Export-first: implement exportable, signed audit bundles + basic retention TTL (fast win).
2) KMS-policy-first: add tenant KMS keys + rotation workflow (medium effort).
3) Full per-tenant retention UI + long-term archive (highest effort).

Lee Torres: sample config sketch for export bundle job: 
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "export_window": { "from": "2023-01-01", "to": "2024-01-01" },
  "signature_algo": "ed25519",
  "include_kv_cache": false
}
```

Priya Nair: on HSM rotation: we should avoid decrypt-reencrypt for large archives. propose lazy rewrap: keep data encrypted with old key but publish rewrap map and rotate when accessed. legal/compliance ok with that? need legal sign-off.

Sarah Patel: customers care about portability — export + chain of custody is the minimum. raising hand: I'll coordinate with the three accounts asking for 7y retention, they need an ETA. can we promise an incremental approach? export + signed bundle first, then retention tiers. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: acceptance criteria draft (suggested): 
- audit export: tenant can request on-demand signed audit bundle, delivered within 24h for <=1TB.
- chain of custody: bundle includes signatures + content manifest + hash list.
- retention control: admin API to set `retention_days` per-tenant (MVP: min 30d, max 3650d).
- KMS: support tenant key enrollment and rotation policy with documented rotation window and FAQ.
- SOC2 automation: generate evidence package for audit window (rolling 90d).

Morgan Blake: questions: SLA on export 24h ok? some customers want realtime stream to their SIEM. can we provide webhook/stream as an opt-in later?

Lee Torres: 24h for on-demand <=1TB is doable as MVP. realtime stream is a separate engineering project (audit-stream service) — estimate 6-8 sprint effort.

Priya Nair: legal note: for EU long retention, we need DSR & deletion exceptions for lawful hold. include legal hold API in scope if we go >1y.

Alex Chen: decision needed: do we A) prioritize export+signed bundles (fast), B) prioritize tenant KMS & rotation (medium), or C) prioritize per-tenant retention UI + archive (slow). please react with :one:, :two:, or :three: and add short note if you have constraints. owners: I'll own A if we pick it. Lee volunteers infra for A. Priya will own compliance checklist for A. Sarah will coordinate customers.

AuditBot: scheduled job audit-exporter v1 ran at 1823451200 — last run 12h ago, 0 failures.

Alex Chen: meeting suggestion: 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to lock decision. if majority picks :one: we'll ship an RFC next week.

Priya Nair: :one: from me. comment: ensure manifest includes key rotation history and signing key id.

Lee Torres: :one: — infra ok. will add storage cost estimate to RFC.

Morgan Blake: :one: but add roadmap item for audit-stream (post-MVP).

Sarah Patel: :one: i'll tell the customers we'd aim for export in Q3 and share timeline after RFC.

Alex Chen: great — consensus on A. I'll draft RFC today and assign owners. meeting canceled. thanks everyone. :rocket:
